title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-27 01:24:26 最新章节：第149章 万剑归宗
slug: 加入合欢宗后师妹的鱼塘炸了
content_zh:
第1章不要做拉屎以外的任何事“师弟，云洛还在里面呢。”
“别怕，说不定她已经死了。”
“万一没死……”
“这样不是更刺激吗？”
“……”
一墙之隔，云洛无语地翻了个白眼，这思过崖，竟是宗门弟子的野合圣地。
被扔进来半个月，所见所闻，胜过阅片无数。
不堪入耳的声音阵阵敲击耳膜，却仍不能转移丹田处令人痛不欲生的绞痛。
半月前。
她被认定偷盗宗门至宝，人赃并获。
未经任何调查，师父段崖当场废掉她的灵根。
她被扔到思过崖，自生自灭。
没有食物和水，只有野鸳鸯给她贡献精神粮食。
现在，她像是在肉文里找剧情的人，看到肉只想跳过。
石壁后的声音开始高亢，有种不顾人死活的疯狂。
听得想让人毁灭这个世界。
云洛拼尽所有力气，来了一场土拨鼠尖叫。
动静戛然而止，男子被她吼得闷哼，女子惊呼：
“师弟，你竟然……”
云洛痛恨自己懂太多。

一阵窸窸窣窣的声音响起，没一会儿，一男一女出现在洞内。
男的高挑俊秀，女的清丽窈窕。
是她的小师弟林霆和三师姐古薇。
云洛看着林霆那张脸，眼底阴沉。
她的今日，全拜此人所赐。
她本来是现代的一名社畜。
一个平凡的周末，她参加了某景区爬山捡水瓶兑换勋章的活动。
可能是前一晚看了两篇闺蜜精心为她创作美味如小作文后没有休息好。
她弯腰捡瓶子时眼前一黑，不慎摔下悬崖。
再睁眼，她胎穿到了修仙界，八岁那年，因为战乱成了孤儿。
躲避战乱的途中，她被天星宗的仙探看上，成为了一名外门弟子。
小时候披床单装仙女，没想到有一天能真修仙。
为了有朝一日能穿上漂亮裙子表演一个天女散花，她刻苦修炼，比老黄牛还努力。
她天资平平，只是中品木灵根，但通过努力，十二岁，便已是筑基强者，恐怖如斯。
段崖见她从引气入体到筑基只花了四年时间，觉得她非池中物，将她收为内门弟子。
从此，她跟着段崖修炼，他待自己不算亲近，但也算负责。
直到一年后，段崖走了狗屎运，不知从哪儿捡到了上品木灵根的林霆。
林霆就像误入大专的清北高材生，受到了所有人的追捧。
content_en:
Chapter 1 Don’t do anything other than shit “Junior brother, Yun Luo is still inside.”
"Don't be afraid, maybe she is dead."
"In case he doesn't die..."
"Wouldn't it be more exciting this way?"
"..."
Separated by a wall, Yun Luo rolled his eyes speechlessly, thinking that this cliff turned out to be the Yehe Holy Land for sect disciples.
After being thrown in for half a month, what I saw and heard was better than reading countless films.
The unbearable sound hit the eardrums repeatedly, but it still could not divert the excruciating cramping pain in the Dantian.
Half a month ago.
She was found guilty of stealing the sect's treasure, and both the person and the person got the stolen goods.
Without any investigation, Master Duan Ya destroyed her spiritual roots on the spot.
She was thrown to Siguo Cliff and left to fend for herself.
Without food or water, only wild mandarin ducks provided her with spiritual food.
Now, she is like someone who is looking for plot in pornographic novels and just wants to skip them when she sees them.
The voice behind the stone wall began to be high-pitched, with a kind of madness that didn't care about people's lives or lives.
It sounds like you want people to destroy the world.
Yunluo tried his best and screamed like a marmot.
The movement stopped suddenly, the man groaned as she yelled at her, and the woman exclaimed:
"Junior brother, you actually..."
Yun Luo hated himself for knowing too much.
There was a rustling sound, and after a while, a man and a woman appeared in the cave.
The man is tall and handsome, and the woman is beautiful and graceful.
It's her younger junior brother Lin Ting and third senior sister Gu Wei.
Yun Luo looked at Lin Ting's face with gloomy eyes.
Her today is all thanks to this person.
She was originally a modern social animal.
On an ordinary weekend, she participated in a mountain climbing activity in a scenic spot to collect water bottles and exchange them for medals.
Maybe it was because she didn't have a good rest after reading two delicious essays written by her best friend for her the night before.
When she bent down to pick up the bottle, her vision went dark and she accidentally fell off the cliff.
When she opened her eyes again, she was transported to the world of immortality. When she was eight years old, she was orphaned due to the war.
While escaping from the war, she was spotted by an immortal detective from the Tianxing Sect and became an outer disciple.
When I was a child, I wore a bed sheet and pretended to be a fairy. I never thought that one day I would actually become an immortal.
In order to one day be able to put on a beautiful dress and perform like a goddess, she practiced hard, even harder than an old scalper.
Her talent is mediocre, she only has a middle-grade wood spirit root, but through hard work, she has become a powerful foundation builder at the age of twelve, which is terrifying.
Duan Ya saw that it only took her four years from introducing Qi into the body to building the foundation. He felt that she was not a creature in the pond and accepted her as an inner disciple.
From then on, she practiced with Duan Ya. He was not close to her, but he was also responsible.
It wasn't until a year later that Duan Ya got lucky and picked up Lin Ting's high-grade wood spirit root from nowhere.
Lin Ting is like a top student from Qingbei who accidentally entered a junior college and was sought after by everyone.
